description: Files a claim, runs its checks; it counts if they pass and test the statement, with a key (none: start or request_key {public: true}). Example: {subject: "a.org", statement: "https://a.org/ is live", checks: [{type: "http", url: "https://a.org/"}]}

api_key.description: your csk_ key, if you cannot send headers

checks.description: checks that fail if it is false

statement.description: the claim, naming its URL or PR

name: submit_claim
